## Welcome to the Microsoft Live Blog


Microsoft is creating a frontier ecosystem where AI tools support the work that people want to accomplish, placing human ambition, intelligence and trust at the forefront of those developments.


Microsoft Ignite is where you’ll get to see what’s next, with new products and features showcasing the latest developments in the frontier ecosystem. With our Microsoft Ignite Live blog, you can follow along in real-time with other business leaders, security experts, IT pros, developers and partners as the announcements unfold.


Here, you’ll get more on the moments that matter, with helpful context on how these breakthroughs connect across Microsoft’s platforms and services, and how you can use them to drive meaningful outcomes now and in the future. You’ll be able to toggle across the blog, Book of News and the Explore More section to stay fully informed.


Bookmark this page and come back on November 17 at 1 pm Eastern/10 am Pacific for the start of Ignite and all the latest news.
